consequence.statement: After the upgrade, the application webhook handler checks semver constraint matching, so webhook-triggered handling may behave differently than before for applications subject to a semver constraint.
consequence.remediation: Verify webhook-triggered handling for applications whose revision tracking involves a semver constraint.

assertion.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes the application webhook handler to check semver constraint matching, so webhook handling now behaves differently than before.
